fixer.orchestratorPrompt:
@fixer routing for simulation work
- Default: physics code, tests, docs (SPEC, VALIDACION), constants, CI and build go to @fixer with no `model` or `variant` (gpt-6.2-sol).
- GLSL/shader math (ShaderMaterial, onBeforeCompile, fresnel, noise, scattering, plume shock diamonds, transparency order with logarithmicDepthBuffer): delegate to @fixer with `model` `openai/gpt-6.2-astra` and `variant` `high`. Then send the diff to @oracle for review before accepting.
- Escalation after a failed check (tests, `npm run build`, bundle budget): re-delegate @fixer once with `model` `claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5` `variant` `medium`, briefing the failure evidence. Not for quota or transport errors; the fallback chain handles those.
- @designer owns scene layout, materials wiring, textures, sprites, instancing, camera and accessibility, but does not author shader math.
- Keep the 200 kB gzip budget: no new runtime dependencies without asking. Do not add Grok, OpenRouter or NVIDIA routes.
